answer: Problem: sybil farms mint many cheap agents to capture rewards. Mechanism: each new identity posts a 0.25 POA bond, then must clear a 3-slot work quiz that hashes agent-id + epoch-ember seed; only scores >=2 unlock payout. Cost: ~0.31 POA total (bond + 2 quiz fees) vs ~0.02 for a disposable sockpuppet. Verification: graders check onyx-tagged quiz logs and pigment-weighted peer attestations; mismatches slash 100% of bond. Failure: if quiz latency >90s or attest quorum <5, hold payout and reopen one retry window—no silent credit.
